about: Regression scenarios for the command line playground. Run with: node tests/run.js regression (see tests/README.md).
Each scenario loads a fresh page; "os": "both" runs it once in Ubuntu mode (name@ubuntu) and once in Mac mode (name@mac).
Steps: "text" = type it and press Enter, then wait for the prompt. {"cmd": "...", "wait": "pager"|"busy"|"idle"|"any"|ms} = the same with another wait.
{"type": "..."} types without Enter. {"key": "Tab"|"Enter"|"ArrowUp"|"Ctrl+C"|"Ctrl+L"|"Space"|"q"|"G"...} presses a key.
{"click": "mac"|"ubuntu"|"perms"|"reset"|"term"|CSS selector}. {"name": "ada"} types into the Your name field.
{"wait": 1500} pauses; {"wait": "tree"} waits until the dot and its trail have gone (do this before Start again or an OS switch that follows a cd).
{"snap": "pager"|"tree"|"terminal"|"screen"|"all"} records that part of the page at that moment. {"check": "dot"} asserts the tree dot is moving.
Optional scenario fields: "viewport": [width, height] (default [1400, 900]) and "theme": "dark" (default light).
At the end the runner waits for the tree to stop animating and records the terminal, the tree, the status line, the prompt and the input.
